proof_body:
by
  intro a b r p q hr
  have hN : 0 ≤ (a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hSq := Real.sq_sqrt hN
  have hS0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2)
  have hbound : ∀ x y : ℝ, (x - a) ^ 2 + (y - b) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 → |(x - a) * (a - p) + (y - b) * (b - q)| ≤ r * Real.sqrt ((a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2) := by
    intro x y h
    apply abs_le_of_sq_le_sq _ (by positivity)
    rw [mul_pow, hSq, ← h]
    linarith [sq_nonneg ((x - a) * (b - q) - (y - b) * (a - p))]
  have hexpand : ∀ x y : ℝ, (x - a) ^ 2 + (y - b) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 → (x - p) ^ 2 + (y - q) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 + 2 * ((x - a) * (a - p) + (y - b) * (b - q)) + Real.sqrt ((a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    intro x y h
    rw [hSq]; linear_combination h
  by_cases h0 : (a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2 = 0
  · have hS : Real.sqrt ((a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2) = 0 := by rw [h0]; simp
    obtain ⟨hA2, hB2⟩ := (add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)).mp h0
    have hA : a - p = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp hA2
    have hB : b - q = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp hB2
    have e₁ : p = a := by linarith
    have e₂ : q = b := by linarith
    subst e₁ e₂
    have hall : ∀ x y : ℝ, (x - p) ^ 2 + (y - q) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 → Real.sqrt ((x - p) ^ 2 + (y - q) ^ 2) = r := by
      intro x y h; rw [h, Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
    rw [hS, zero_add, zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hr]
    constructor
    · refine ⟨⟨p + r, q, by ring, (hall _ _ (by ring)).symm⟩, ?_⟩
      rintro s ⟨x, y, h, rfl⟩
      exact (hall x y h).le
    · refine ⟨⟨p + r, q, by ring, (hall _ _ (by ring)).symm⟩, ?_⟩
      rintro s ⟨x, y, h, rfl⟩
      exact (hall x y h).ge
  · have hpos : 0 < (a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hN (Ne.symm h0)
    have hS : 0 < Real.sqrt ((a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, d = Real.sqrt ((a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hd] at hS hS0 hSq hbound hexpand ⊢
    have hon : ∀ e : ℝ, e ^ 2 = 1 → (a + e * r * (a - p) / d - a) ^ 2 + (b + e * r * (b - q) / d - b) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
      intro e he
      have : (a + e * r * (a - p) / d - a) ^ 2 + (b + e * r * (b - q) / d - b) ^ 2 = e ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * ((a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2) / d ^ 2 := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [this, he, ← hSq]; field_simp
    have hval : ∀ e : ℝ, e ^ 2 = 1 → (a + e * r * (a - p) / d - p) ^ 2 + (b + e * r * (b - q) / d - q) ^ 2 = (d + e * r) ^ 2 := by
      intro e he
      have : (a + e * r * (a - p) / d - p) ^ 2 + (b + e * r * (b - q) / d - q) ^ 2 = (1 + e * r / d) ^ 2 * ((a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2) := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [this, ← hSq]; field_simp
    constructor
    · refine ⟨⟨a + 1 * r * (a - p) / d, b + 1 * r * (b - q) / d, hon 1 (by norm_num), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [hval 1 (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]; ring
      · rintro s ⟨x, y, h, rfl⟩
        rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity), hexpand x y h]
        have := (abs_le.mp (hbound x y h)).2
        have e : (d + r) ^ 2 = d ^ 2 + 2 * (r * d) + r ^ 2 := by ring
        linarith
    · refine ⟨⟨a + (-1) * r * (a - p) / d, b + (-1) * r * (b - q) / d, hon (-1) (by norm_num), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [hval (-1) (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]; congr 1; ring
      · rintro s ⟨x, y, h, rfl⟩
        apply Real.abs_le_sqrt
        rw [hexpand x y h]
        have := (abs_le.mp (hbound x y h)).1
        have e : (d - r) ^ 2 = d ^ 2 - 2 * (r * d) + r ^ 2 := by ring
        linarith
target_source: ∀ (a b r p q : ℝ), 0 < r → IsGreatest {s : ℝ | ∃ x y : ℝ, (x - a) ^ 2 + (y - b) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 ∧ s = Real.sqrt ((x - p) ^ 2 + (y - q) ^ 2)} (Real.sqrt ((a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2) + r) ∧ IsLeast {s : ℝ | ∃ x y : ℝ, (x - a) ^ 2 + (y - b) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 ∧ s = Real.sqrt ((x - p) ^ 2 + (y - q) ^ 2)} |Real.sqrt ((a - p) ^ 2 + (b - q) ^ 2) - r|
